title: The deposit and the final settlement
description: Payments are tied to one job, and the balance can be checked against the history.

blocks.text: When the deposit is recorded in a spreadsheet on the side, the client and the person doing the work easily end up seeing different amounts owed.

quote.text: I wish they incorporated a way to seamlessly accept down payments.

blocks.text: Keep every payment received with its date, show the original scope and the current balance. Make refunds and corrections separate events.
The client’s payment and the money reaching the person doing the work can happen at different times; the statuses have to be told apart.
